title: parse_milestones treats crosslink 'No milestones found.' as Unusable, not an empty list
description:
Discovered during Slice-1 finding-join dogfood (#820).

vsdd-core/src/snapshot/acquire.rs parse_milestones treats crosslink's empty-state human output 'No milestones found.' as whole-format drift -> None -> AcquisitionOutcome::Unusable, instead of an empty milestone list. On any repo with no crosslink milestones (this one included), acquire_snapshot short-circuits to Unusable and never reaches the session or finding-query legs.

Repro: 'crosslink milestone list' -> 'No milestones found.'; acquire_snapshot(repo) -> Unusable.

Impact: the live status answer + the finding-query join are unreachable on no-milestone repos. Pre-existing (Layer 1/2 milestone leg); outside the Slice-1 finding-join build scope, so filed + routed rather than fixed inline.

Fix direction: parse_milestones should recognize crosslink's empty-state message as a lawful empty list (0 milestones), distinct from unparseable drift. Needs its own red-gate test (empty-message -> Some(empty), not None). Relates to #820.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Routing (plan): route to the fix lane — a defect in the Layer 1/2 milestone leg (parse_milestones), outside the current Slice-1 finding-join build scope. Fix carries its own red gate: 'No milestones found.' parses to Some(empty list), not None; the existing empty_output_is_an_empty_list test extends to the crosslink empty-state wording. No contract touch.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed on branch fix-milestone-empty-parse (commit 8ea6a155, off main — independent of the #820 PR). parse_milestones now recognizes crosslink's 'No milestones found.' empty-state (declared-mirror const EMPTY_MILESTONE_LIST) as a lawful empty list; genuine drift still fails loud (content_with_zero test preserved). Red gate observed (crosslink_empty_state_message_is_an_empty_list failed against the prior parser, green after). cargo test --workspace + clippy + mdatron all green. Awaits operator push + PR; end-to-end 'vsdd status' works once this and the #820 join are both on main.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Resolved: merged to main via PR #7 (commit a8888cd2). main green (mdatron 0.4.0 verify clean, workspace tests pass).
